propositions: _lib_writes.py is at or above the 800-line module-size ceiling and blocks landing sibling stories that add create_ticket arguments
The module aggregates seven distinct concerns (genesis, identity, status lifecycle, leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance, signing) on independent growth axes
Splitting by concern into _lib_mutations.py (concerns 4+5+6) and _lib_identity.py (concerns 2+7) reduces _lib_writes.py to ~378 lines while keeping both new modules within the 200-500 target band
All 27 public names remain re-exported from _lib_writes with noqa markers, preserving rebar.<name> and rebar._lib_writes.<name> paths so __init__.py and _lib_gates.py require no edit
The three-module split is behaviour-preserving: every top-level block from the original file relocates byte-identically, with only docstrings, imports, and re-export blocks as new text
The split unblocks the sibling story adding two optional create_ticket arguments by providing ~256 lines of headroom to _lib_writes.py
